Policies and Initiatives.title: Union Budget 2026: Kerala finds barely a mention; leaders across spectrum, except BJP, flay neglect
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Kerala received minimal mention in the Union Budget 2026, prompting criticism from state leaders across the political spectrum, except the BJP. Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan termed the Budget a deliberate attempt to hinder Kerala's development, while Leader of the Opposition V.D. Satheesan questioned whether Kerala is considered part of India. The neglect has sparked widespread disappointment among Kerala's leaders.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Industry forums in Kerala welcome development proposals in Union Budget
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Industry forums in Kerala, including FICCI and the Indian Chamber of Commerce & Industry, Cochin, have welcomed development proposals in the Union Budget. The initiatives focus on bolstering manufacturing, with significant funding allocated to bio-pharma and electronic components. The proposals are expected to support the growth of key industries in the region.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Union Budget disappointing: K.N. Balagopal
Policies and Initiatives.summary: K.N. Balagopal expressed disappointment with the Union Budget. Kerala has been selected for the 'Rare Earth Corridor' scheme, which the state aims to leverage to establish related industries. The state's goal is to have these industries set up within Kerala.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Left, Congress leaders slam Union Budget for ignoring Kerala
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Left and Congress leaders have criticized the Union Budget for neglecting Kerala's interests, with M.A. Baby stating it favors big corporate houses. M.V. Govindan described the Budget as "a declaration of war" against Kerala, while Chennithala termed it a "complete disappointment". The leaders expressed strong opposition to the Budget's alleged disregard for the state's needs.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Union Budget 2026: Mountain, turtle, birdwatching trails to come up in Himachal, Jammu & Kashmir, Odisha, Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Union Budget 2026 will fund the development of mountain, turtle, and birdwatching trails in several Indian states, including Himachal, Jammu & Kashmir, Odisha, Karnataka, Kerala, and Tamil Nadu. A birdwatching trail will be specifically developed along the Pulicat Lake on the Andhra Pradesh-Tamil Nadu border. These projects aim to promote eco-tourism in these regions.

Events.title: Regional AI Conference at Thiruvananthapuram
Events.summary: A regional AI conference is being held in Thiruvananthapuram, bringing together experts and enthusiasts to discuss artificial intelligence. The conference aims to promote knowledge sharing and collaboration in the field of AI. Details about the conference, including its schedule and speakers, are not specified.
